entities.name: Yadira
entities.description: Leader of Lathril's elven clan on Skemfar, a dignified and authoritative figure.

entities.name: Lathril
entities.description: Elven queen who ascended to divine power and was tasked by Yadira with an Omenpath problem.

entities.name: Skemfar
entities.description: Realm of Kaldheim where Yadira's clan lives.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane on which Skemfar lies.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: A magical passage between realms that posed a problem for the elves.

events.summary: After Lathril's ascension, Yadira summons Lathril and Lukya and tasks her with an Omenpath problem.
events.quote: She informed Lathril about a problem involving an Omenpath and tasked her with addressing it

relations.quote: Yadira summoned the queen and her wolf companion Lukya to address a pressing issue
